Subtracting the equations: 2p = 182 − 124 = 58, so p = 29 cents (and e = 124 − 87 = 37).

Solution A multiplied the first equation by -5 but then added it incorrectly. It gave -4e, and it also made an error in the constant, so its answer of 4.83 is wrong.

Solution B has the wrong elimination result: -15p - 5e + 5p + e = -10p - 4e, so p is not eliminated. Its final answer of 27 is also wrong.

Neither is correct. The correct answer is 29. Of the two, B's final answer (27) is closer to 29, but neither is right, so I'll pick the one nearer the truth.

WINNER: B
